name: Gibson Environment Dataset
summary: 由真实空间扫描构建的可导航三维环境集合，配合 Gibson 模拟器生成 RGB、深度、语义和智能体轨迹，面向具身感知与导航。
summaryEn: A collection of navigable 3D environments reconstructed from real scans, used with Gibson to generate RGB, depth, semantics, and agent trajectories.
scale: 572 full buildings across multiple quality tiers
scaleZh: 572 个完整建筑场景，分为多个质量等级
license: Gibson dataset terms; research and non-commercial restrictions apply
licenseZh: 适用 Gibson 数据条款；包含研究及非商业限制
wmNote: 可用于生成导航轨迹，但旧版 Gibson 工具链已归档，现代项目通常应评估 iGibson 等后继方案。
wmNoteEn: Useful for navigation rollouts, though the original toolkit is archived and newer successors may be preferable.
